# HAPI v0.30.7.5

## Compared with the previous maintained release

- Rebased onto 15 new official main commits: Russian locale (web/Android/iOS), 130% font size, Codex goal cards, larger dictation/send buttons, orphan HAPI MCP bridge reaping, agent-context env stripped from web Terminal PTYs, automatic Codex compaction notice, Codex status summaries kept out of intermediate messages (#2041), pasting non-image files into the composer (#2026), configurable ElevenLabs conversation duration, session search/toolbar layout fixes.
- New carries:
  - Codex/runner: reconnect live Codex roots on resume (#1940), runner webhook adoption bound to the reporting process (#1943), non-blocking and fewer Windows process probes (#2035, #2046), Codex model catalog reuse (#1938), persisted Codex Round duration (#2025), webhook timeout hint (#2066), local-mode stdin handoff (#1932).
  - Hub: keepalive-idle reconciliation (#1942), single-flight session enumeration RPCs (#2032), localId minted for sends without one (#2069).
  - Web: keepalive-idle indicators (#1944), retry failed aborts (#1955), tail-follow through layout scroll (#1960), Terminal "To agent" control (#2012), composer image previews kept across updates (#2070), archive cleanup progress (#2061), explanation for redirected hub requests (#2065).
  - Agents: DSH abort via session/close (#2027), official `dsh --profile acp` default entrypoint (#2031), Pi inline tool-result images (#2060).
- Refreshed personal carries #1436 (voice direct-sends carry a localId; draft hydration fixes) and #1771 (spawned runtime confirmation, logical cwd, terminal exit confirmation). #1419 was closed upstream; its send-button behavior stays only through the open #1436 carrier.
- #2024 is covered by the #1771 carry. #2028 and #2071 are deferred because they conflict with carried changes.
- Dropped overlay iOS test corrections now covered by official #1907 and the #1771 carry. No other feature removals.

## Compared with the official release

- Rebuilt from official main 5d8deb201189dc1f183c4f5bf38c87ec4d34dd70 (official release train v0.30.7), with 47 audited open PR carries (two integrated without a separate patch).
- Includes the maintained session-control workflow, voice draft delivery, notification, composer, session-list, file-search, Codex runner and DSH fixes listed above.
- Retains signed macOS CLI artifacts, standalone Linux/Windows CLIs, desktop packages, four-part release gates and a replayable release manifest.
- Fork-only features removed in v0.30.7.3 remain omitted. Closed unmerged PR #847 remains absent; PR #1320 is never replayed as a carry.

Complete per-PR decisions and personal policy exceptions: tools/maintenance/releases/v0.30.7.5/.
